title: Run read-only Development Engine pilot against Lot45
objective: Apply the current Development Engine to the exact suspended Lot45 PR #66 candidate using GitHub read evidence only, record how the engine decomposes/classifies/assures the candidate, and surface engine defects without modifying Lot45, main, business state, workflows or runtime permissions.
non_goals: change runtime trading execution risk or permission boundaries
change mandatory workflows or engine policies during the pilot
require Codex or any paid LLM reviewer

required_invariants: pilot observations are bound to exact PR #66 base and head SHAs
pilot is read-only toward the Lot45 candidate and main
current engine policies are observed rather than changed during ENG-09.1
candidate changed files and CI evidence are classified without trusting PR prose as proof
missing unavailable or stale evidence remains an explicit gap rather than an assumed PASS
Lot45 remains SUSPENDED_CANDIDATE Lot46 remains LOCKED and BUSINESS remains PAUSED
BOOT-FINDING-001 remains visible and cannot be bypassed by pilot success
no Codex or other paid LLM review is mandatory for pilot progress
acceptance_criteria: pilot verifies current main PR #66 base/head/open/unmerged reality before analysis
pilot inventories the exact Lot45 changed-file set and groups it by engine impact/domain
pilot maps candidate impacts to T0 T1 T2 and T3/T4 requirements using current policies
pilot inventories exact current workflow/check evidence and identifies missing stale failed or redundant evidence without modifying it
pilot records whether the Development Engine itself exposes defects or friction
pilot evidence/report contain no business merge/unlock authorization
pilot writes only ENG-09 evidence/report and governance transition files

done_when: Lot45 pilot evidence is exact-head bound and reproducible from GitHub observations
engine-selected validation and assurance requirements are recorded without candidate mutation
pilot defects/redundancies are routed to ENG-09.2 or ENG-09.3 instead of silently patched inside the candidate
BUSINESS remains PAUSED and Lot46 remains LOCKED
